Definition: from the same as G109; mist:--vapour.
BiblicalUsage: Vapour is the word for mist, and it appears in the signs of the last days and in the picture of a life. Peter quotes Joel that there will be blood and fire and vapour of smoke, and James asks what your life is, for it is even a vapour that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a vapour is the honest measure of my life, and the wonder is that God breathes eternity into something so brief.
RelatedPeople: Simon Peter; James, Brother of the Lord
